description: Small evidence-backed glossary for the qualitative caption evaluation corpus. Entries constrain name rendering only; they do not supply full translations.
evidence_note: Only entities evidenced in the saved evaluation fixtures are included. Aliases are limited to source spellings found in those fixtures; this glossary is not a complete franchise/person index.

entries.note: ラーラ supports the Laala component. マナカラーラ is a noisy phonetic transcript, so do not treat it alone as proof of the canonical full name; name correctness checks in that packet intentionally omit a required full-name substring.
